title: Collective is a Space plan again above Business, and the catalog holds Collective, the extra member Space and Non Profit Collective
detail:
PHASE 1 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. SPACE_PLANS gains collective as the rung above Business (the remap to business goes), catalog re-opens collective_base at 14900/149000 and adds collective_space 2900/29000 and nonprofit_collective 11900/119000, a Collective sell switch stays off, the admin pricing console stops reading a missing catalog row, and space_billing_agreements re-admits collective (migration). scripts/check-collective.mjs is inverted in the same PR. Production plan_collective_enabled read TRUE on 2026-10-06 (the brief said off); the owner ruled 2026-10-06 (decision card) to leave it on, so Collective is purchasable once this merges and OWN-094 mints its Stripe prices. Public pages advertise it at LIVE-759.

Shipped: SPACE_PLANS carries collective and nonprofit_collective with an explicit capability rank (PLAN_CAPABILITY_RANK; gates and the display ladder rank by it, so Non Profit never clears a Collective floor). Catalog re-opens collective_base 14900 and adds collective_space 2900 (per Space) and nonprofit_collective 11900; checkout bills them under plan_collective_enabled; Collective includes Vera AI; subscription items reconcile to collective. Migration 20270346003000 widens the agreements and item_key CHECKs (repairing production drift: item_key lacked collective and independent) and seeds plan.collective / plan.nonprofit_collective. The admin pricing console renders the three items (it read a missing collective_base row before). check-collective.mjs now asserts Collective is a live plan.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const p=r("lib/pricing/plans.ts");const m=p.match(/SPACE_PLANS = \[([^\]]*)\]/);if(!m||!/\x27collective\x27/.test(m[1]))fail("SPACE_PLANS has no collective plan");const rk=(p.split("PLAN_CAPABILITY_RANK")[1]||"");const rb=rk.match(/business: (\d)/),rc=rk.match(/collective: (\d)/);if(!rb||!rc||Number(rc[1])<=Number(rb[1]))fail("collective does not rank above business");if(/\n\s*collective: \x27business\x27/.test(p))fail("collective still remaps to business");const k=r("lib/billing/pricing-keys.ts");for(const key of ["collective_base","collective_space","nonprofit_collective"])if(!new RegExp("CATALOG_ITEM_KEYS = \\[[^\\]]*\x27"+key+"\x27").test(k))fail(key+" is not a catalog item");for(const amt of ["14900, 14900","2900, 2900","11900, 11900"])if(!k.includes("amountsFromMonthly("+amt+")"))fail("no catalog amount "+amt);if(/RETIRED_CATALOG_ITEM_KEYS[^\]]*\x27collective_base\x27/.test(k))fail("collective_base is still retired");console.log("ok: Collective is a plan and the three new prices are in the catalog")'
